summary: The article profiles Huang Wei of Harbin as an example of an SME founder who turned his software vision into reality, presenting five strategies from his journey. These are building sound foundations, treating failure as a stepping stone, prioritizing consumer feedback, leveraging local networks, and continuous learning and adaptation. It frames founder stories as showing that business is driven by human motivation and passion as much as profits.
one_line: Profile of Harbin software founder Huang Wei and the five strategies behind his SME's growth, from team foundations to continuous adaptation.
key_facts: The article focuses on founders of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) who turned visions into realities after September 1, 2023.
Huang Wei of Harbin is presented as the example founder whose ventures have transformed the software sector.
On November 5, 2023, Huang Wei began building his company by gathering a team of talented individuals who shared his vision of innovative software solutions.
Huang Wei chose diverse, complementary skill sets to build a secure foundation and crafted a mission statement with his team to guide every decision.
In early January 2024, one of Huang Wei's software applications failed to gain traction, and he studied its shortcomings and market responses instead of giving up.
Huang Wei shared lessons from the failure with his team, creating an environment where failure was seen as necessary feedback and building resilience.
Beginning in February 2025, Huang Wei adopted an iterative development method: launch, get feedback, improve, and repeat.
Huang Wei's team collected consumer feedback after each release, and this customer-first focus was key to his rise in the competitive software marketplace.
During Harbin's summer 2025 ecosystem, Huang Wei built relationships with fellow entrepreneurs, tech experts, and business incubators in Harbin, gaining partnerships, mentorships, and support.
By fall 2026, continuous learning was part of Huang Wei's approach: he attended courses and industry conferences and followed technological innovations.
Huang Wei revised his business model to incorporate emerging technologies, entering new markets and becoming an influential tech player.
The article concludes that every successful business owes its success to a human who dared to dream.
